idea: Clear the positive denominators and express the resulting difference as a sum of three nonnegative terms, each a positive pairwise sum times a square.
proof:
rcases h₀ with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  have hs : 0 < x + y + z := by positivity
  have hxy : 0 < x + y := by positivity
  have hyz : 0 < y + z := by positivity
  have hzx : 0 < z + x := by positivity
  have hd : 0 < (x + y) * (y + z) * (z + x) := by positivity
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (x + y) * (y - x)^2 :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hxy) (sq_nonneg (y - x))
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (y + z) * (z - y)^2 :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hyz) (sq_nonneg (z - y))
  have h3 : 0 ≤ (z + x) * (x - z)^2 :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hzx) (sq_nonneg (x - z))
  have hp :
      9 * ((x + y) * (y + z) * (z + x)) ≤
        2 * ((y + z) * (z + x) + (z + x) * (x + y) +
          (x + y) * (y + z)) * (x + y + z) := by
    nlinarith only [h1, h2, h3]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hs).2
  calc
    (9 : ℝ) ≤
        (2 * ((y + z) * (z + x) + (z + x) * (x + y) +
          (x + y) * (y + z)) * (x + y + z)) /
          ((x + y) * (y + z) * (z + x)) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hd).2 hp
    _ = (2 / (x + y) + 2 / (y + z) + 2 / (z + x)) *
        (x + y + z) := by
      field_simp
      <;> ring
insight_proof:
rcases h₀ with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (x + y) * (y - x)^2 := by positivity
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (y + z) * (z - y)^2 := by positivity
  have h3 : 0 ≤ (z + x) * (x - z)^2 := by positivity
  nlinarith only [h1, h2, h3]
